items.text: That's helpful, thanks! I've been thinking of exploring the waterfront path, but I was wondering if you know if it's open to cyclists during the week, or is it more of a weekend thing?
I was thinking of exploring the waterfront path on Thursday evening, after my volleyball league game.
I was thinking of maybe stopping by a cafe or restaurant along the waterfront to grab a bite to eat after my ride. Do you have any recommendations for good places to eat around there?
